source_fact: The completed initial96/old73-byte conformance proves the guarded initial continuation for the frozen communication policy. It does not validate starting a new predictor at an actual later decision.

already_supplied.physical_population: The validated later bundle has all five public job contracts/lifecycle states, three trays, exact owner/generation/public traversal/committed prefix, all node occupancy and no additional reception lease. Delivered destination-owned receipts explicitly cover completed jobs; absence is never completion.
already_supplied.next_autonomous_events: Typed loading/unloading/hold/Storage/local-service bounds and actual source-observed committed-edge entry/exit facts are retained. Historical final-edge service bounds are separately derived from the deciding owner's actual publication self-ACK history. A successful guard requires every relevant transition to remain outside the capture-union interval.
already_supplied.actions: Every source reports its full submitted physical ID/kind set and a terminal delivered ACK strictly before the union floor. The deciding owner additionally retains its immutable own submission prefix and own endpoint responses. Peer action rows do not contain the peer's original payload.
already_supplied.owner_messages: The complete normalized own view remains in SuppliedContext.evidence, including delivered_messages and own client endpoints; only the compact validated bundle drops these auxiliary fields. Own demand observations must be taken from this actual evidence, not regenerated from remote current jobs.
already_supplied.loading_available_semantics: loading.available_at is the observed future load-completion bound, not necessarily the underlying old empty-availability epoch. Preserve the typed field and never reset it to0 as if a later seed were the initial fixture. For unloading, completion is still an actual future event, not inferred as already done.

not_a_complete_restart_state: The original Projection constructor resets next_entry, service calendars, FIFO/wait/ranking subscriptions, last_arbitration, event sequence and ready-event deduplication. A later SuppliedContext cannot be passed to that constructor and called a faithful continuation.

Peer immutable route/transfer payloads and Python policy fields (started/seen/reply budget/quiet/pending reply) are not transmitted by physical-action coverage. A terminal ACK proves resolution of that operation, not every detail of the peer controller state.

The latest capture does not expose all past edge-entry times, so residual headway cannot generally be assumed expired. Active moving entry receipts supply only the exact current edge; retained lawful older entries or a conservative clearance proof are required elsewhere.

Node occupancy alone does not encode native queue ordering or historical beacon state. Equal physical timestamps do not prove equal native event-order cuts. Relative event order must follow source semantics or remain unknown.
A projected future message is conditional data. Matching the current supplied snapshot does not turn a conditional model event heap into a native checkpoint or certify hidden current state.

minimal_support_order.first: Implement phase B first_reuse_route only, after successful actual collection, before the current route is submitted. L must be the exact loaded reuse1 tray at7, uncommitted, with now+.01 strictly before its authentic service bound. Earlier return and both initial coordinates are immutable.
minimal_support_order.physical_restriction: Require no currently ready/waiting/dispatch-pending tray, no unresolved physical action, complete receiving accounting, and every other tray either stable completed empty/hold, stable Storage, stable unloading, stable local service with an authentic exact bound, or actual observed in-flight edge with a strictly future exit. Initially exclude E loading from restart support until its underlying availability representation has a separate source proof. Do not lower the existing guard.
minimal_support_order.calendar_and_headway: Seed active source service and non-goal incoming service reservations from authentic exact bounds. Goal service must retain accepted027's no-destination-calendar exception. For every previously used edge, either use a retained actually delivered entry time or prove its headway cleared from a lawful upper bound; missing proof returns unknown. Expired calendars may be omitted only with a source-derived proof that their removal cannot alter subsequent ranking notifications.
minimal_support_order.fifo_and_ties: No old waiting queue may be silently reconstructed by tray name. The restricted domain must prove the old queue empty and all new queue insertions follow the unchanged event rules. Future equal-priority ties with unresolved ancestral sequence remain unknown; alternatively retain a source-derived conditional prefix state and validate its observable projection, explicitly without native-state certification.
minimal_support_order.communication: Keep the actual completed local collection/one-fresh budget and immutable own request ledger. Before declaring peer phase state known, derive the necessary phase transition from the actual delivered invitation/reply and documented fixed policy. Do not read the other owner's saved view or private ledger. Any missing demand/peer-reply ordering that affects the next return remains unknown.
minimal_support_order.second: Only after phase B chosen-continuation conformance, support phase A first_return with its actual delivered demand, optional absolute7.84 not-before, later collection and fresh-pair policy. This requires the additional E-loading representation and pending-message proof; it is not a simple reuse of the phase-B seed.

next_pure_interfaces_for_review.support: continuation_support(actual_supplied_later_context, lawful_retained_initial_context, deciding_owner_prefix) -> field-level known/derived/unknown report with provenance. No model evaluation or authority minting.
next_pure_interfaces_for_review.candidate: A separate seed_from_supported_context builds a fresh conditional state only after the support proof closes. A later native adapter independently establishes exact LocalTransport/session/admission origin and rechecks current L/action/wire guards before any command.
next_pure_interfaces_for_review.cost_candidate: The already saved single-request context plan remains separate: revalidate one immutable initial snapshot once per decision and share only that result/static facts across32 candidates. Keep each candidate's dynamic state and every projected future collection guard isolated. All context setup, copies and output are charged.

saved_endpoint_gate_before_prediction: Use all192 successful final later collections from the frozen96, and retain all34 failed first collections as rejected support cases. Do not select only the mechanism's positive route.

Extract only each deciding owner's exact raw endpoints, retained public contracts, and actual own calls before that decision. Full raw future outcomes, case-result labels and peer private endpoints are not support inputs.

At phase A, test whether all four suffix actions share the same authenticated observed prefix for each initial route/E-window family. At phase B, group only histories whose already-issued return matches; two unique remaining route actions. A common ceiling4 may retain declared duplicates, but no method receives hidden savings.

Do not expect raw message IDs or post-clock metadata to be identical across branches automatically. Define explicit identity-preserving within-branch guards and a separate physical sufficient-state equality relation; a different preceding action or collection clock must not be erased.

Only after the source support gate is reviewed, run a new bounded pure continuation conformance: chosen remaining five endpoints, action statuses/edges and ordered later information events against all applicable actual rows, with every unsupported row still unknown. No old initial prediction is substituted for a suffix prediction.

Counterfactual suffixes then use the same evaluator, information and budget for ordinary coordinate, plateau coordinate, pair repair LNS adaptation and finite MPC. Internal unprotected proposals remain allowed; only the common final protection/execution rule restricts deployment. Complete fixed-initial/later-default references remain explicit.
